stage: M0 within-layer reanalysis of existing results
evidence_label: VALIDATION reanalysis; no model, SAE, activation or test row is loaded

questions.SQ5: Within a layer, does SAE reconstruction error predict (a) loss of the GoT-cities truth readout and (b) behavioural splice damage?
questions.SQ1_fairness: Per-layer architecture comparison with the L0 difference made explicit (L0 adjustment, effective width).
questions.corrections: Pooled-across-layer correlations vs within-layer; splicing SAE-vs-random ratio range.

inputs_validation_only.results/shared/spliced_evaluation/unifie: OWT validation reconstruction (EV, L0, dead fraction), OWT/GoT splice outcomes
inputs_validation_only.results/geometry_of_truth/all_layer_froz: rows domain=geographic, eval_set=validation ONLY (task reconstruction error, task L0, frozen-probe gaps)
inputs_validation_only.results/openwebtext/sae_sparsity_sweep/l: 1000-step sweep, local log-NMSE vs log-L0 elasticity between targets 64 and 128

units: 108 SAEs = 12 layers x {relu, topk, jumprelu} x seeds {42, 1042, 2042}; matched_10pct == False (layer 0 JumpReLU seed 42, L0 73.6) excluded from every analysis (flagged, not deleted)

variables.log_owt_nmse: log(1 - OWT validation EV)  [lower error is better]
variables.log_got_rel_err: log(||x - x_hat||^2 / ||x||^2) on GoT cities+neg_cities validation final tokens. Task NMSE (normalised by the task-set variance) is NOT used as predictor: the final-token variance on the task set is tiny, so task NMSE > 1 at layers 1-10 and mainly measures that variance [lower is better]
variables.got_logistic_gap: frozen logistic AUROC(original x) - AUROC(x_hat), GoT geographic validation, informative layers 4-11 only (original AUROC >= 0.70) [lower is better]
variables.owt_delta_ce: OWT validation CE(spliced x_hat at all non-BOS positions) - CE(original), nats/token [lower is better]

primary_model: outcome ~ beta * predictor + layer fixed effects + architecture fixed effects + gamma * log(OWT validation L0)
secondary_model: same without architecture fixed effects (does the lower-error SAE within a layer, whatever its architecture, do better?); reported, not Holm-corrected

inference.permutation: Freedman-Lane: residuals of the nuisance-only model permuted WITHIN layer, 5000 permutations, statistic |t| of beta, p = (1 + #>=)/(1 + 5000). Refinement of the plan's 'shuffle NMSE within layer', fixed before running: it keeps the nuisance structure intact.
inference.ci: 2000 bootstrap resamples of runs within layer; percentile 95% CI of beta
inference.standardised_beta: beta x within-layer sd(predictor) / within-layer sd(outcome)

hypothesis_H0_M0: within a layer, higher reconstruction error goes with larger information and behaviour loss (beta > 0)
decision_rule: Report beta with 95% CI and Holm-adjusted permutation p across the 4 primary pairs. A pair counts as SUPPORTED if p_holm < 0.05 and beta > 0; CONTRADICTED if p_holm < 0.05 and beta < 0; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED (no within-layer evidence). 'Reconstruction predicts faithfulness' stays in the thesis only for SUPPORTED pairs.

architecture_table.per_layer: mean and sd over seeds of OWT val NMSE, OWT val L0, GoT-prompt L0, live latents = 3072 x (1 - dead fraction), OWT dCE, OWT KL, GoT statement KL, GoT task error, GoT gaps
architecture_table.pairwise: relative NMSE difference and Welch p on log NMSE (n = 3 vs 3; descriptive); relative L0 difference; break-even elasticity = the log-NMSE/log-L0 elasticity at which the L0 difference alone would explain the NMSE difference; L0-adjusted NMSE (each SAE moved to L0 = 128 along its own layer x architecture sweep elasticity); whether the ranking flips after adjustment
architecture_table.limitation_declared: sweep elasticities come from 1000-step runs, seed 42 only; the adjustment is a sensitivity analysis, not a matched comparison

corrections: pooled vs within-layer Spearman for every earlier pooled claim, incl. the HISTORICAL RepE ones (reported only to show the pooling artefact)
range of owt__sae_vs_random_delta_ce_ratio over matched runs (earlier text said 1.0-2.6x)
